item.title: 盘屿 0.9.2
item.description:
盘屿 0.9.2
· 新功能：“在 Mac 上检查”发现文件夹里有失效的条目（指向已删除的文件或文件夹）时，可以在征得你同意后直接在 Mac 上删除这些条目并开启读写；删除前会先备份，任何一步不通过都会还原。Windows 的磁盘检查仍是更稳妥的办法。 · 改进：“在 Mac 上检查”更严格，会核对每个目录条目是否仍指向原来的文件；检查失败时显示更具体的技术信息（不含文件名）。 · 新功能：拷贝到不同的磁盘可以同时进行；拷到同一块盘的任务会排队等待。
对应源码：https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.2-74-source.tar.gz

Volisle 0.9.2
· New: when "Check on This Mac" finds folder entries pointing to files or folders that were deleted, Volisle can remove those entries on your Mac, with your consent, and turn on writing. Everything it changes is backed up first and restored if any step fails. Checking the disk in Windows is still the safer option. · Improved: "Check on This Mac" is stricter and verifies that every folder entry still points to the original file; when it fails, it shows more specific technical details (without file names). · New: copies to different disks now run at the same time; copies to the same disk wait in line.
Source code: https://qisw.top/volisle/updates/Volisle-0.9.2-74-source.tar.gz
